column11: Why does FNH retain hepatobiliary contrast while its central scar does not?

column11: What biologic evolution explains arterialization and washout in hepatocellular carcinoma?

Imaging pivot: acquisition of arterial neovascularity is the key transition from background nodules to the classic HCC enhancement pattern.
